definitions.TRUE: The supplied context establishes the queried restriction as an operative mandatory requirement.
definitions.FALSE: The supplied context establishes that the queried characteristic is not an operative mandatory restriction.
definitions.UNKNOWN: The supplied context does not establish whether the queried restriction is operative.

paraphrases.TRUE: The evidence shows that the requirement described in the query applies mandatorily.
paraphrases.FALSE: The evidence shows that the characteristic in the query is not imposed as a mandatory requirement.
paraphrases.UNKNOWN: There is insufficient evidence to determine whether the queried requirement is mandatory.
